$comment: The Question glossary terms backing the Scouting 'Questions' checklist and — more
load-bearing than it looks — SurveyDefinitionReader's scoped candidate lookup, which joins
question display names to their Egeria GUIDs and follows ScopedBy to the Survey Definitions
that answer them. When this batch is missing, that lookup finds nothing and every Survey-tab
load silently falls back to a full instance scan (~20s vs ~0.2s).
Runs after foundations (see ../_folder_order.json): these terms are created inside the
'User Questions' glossary and scoped to funnel-stage/perspective terms defined there.
CANARY CHOICE — keyed on display_name, NOT qualified_name. Dr.Egeria generates term
qualified names as '<Org>::Term::<Hyphenated-Display-Name>::<version>', embedding a
deployment-specific org prefix and version, so hard-coding one is exactly wrong. This is the
reverse of the foundations batch, whose Perspective qualified names ARE author-controlled —
hence _batch.json supporting either key rather than mandating one.
HISTORICAL (resolved 2026-08-20): this canary could not previously be the last term in the
document. Egeria's repository connector doubled every apostrophe on persist ('what''s'), so
two of the 41 terms could never be found by their real name — and a canary that never
resolves marks its batch missing forever and re-heals on every check, which for the
non-idempotent survey-definition batch means repeated duplicate-link damage. That was
egeria-python PYEGERIA_ISSUES.md ISSUE-69, fixed server-side and verified here the same day:
a freshly authored term with apostrophes now stores correctly, and re-authoring this document
repaired both affected terms. All 41 now resolve. The canary below is the document's last
term, which is the strongest completion signal available.
2026-10-22: the canary is Q-0095's term, no longer the document's last. The old canary (Q-0042) was retired and is
no longer in the document, and the document's last terms are new (Q-0098 onward) and not yet in Egeria: a canary on
one of them would read the batch as missing and make a restart re-run it before the cleared Egeria update. Q-0095's
text is unchanged and long established. Move the canary to the document's last term once that update has run.
Terms are generated from ../resource_questions.csv (the source of truth) via
scripts/csv_to_dr_egeria_questions.py — edit the CSV and regenerate, don't hand-edit the md.
